intent: Among the events attended by more than 10 members of the Student_Club, how many of them are meetings?

intent: What is the average attendance of meetings in 2020?

intent: Was each expense in October Meeting on October 8, 2019 approved?
description: event_name = 'October Meeting' where event_date = '2019-10-08'; approved = True means expenses was approved; approved = False means expenses was not approved
source_sql: SELECT T3.approved FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND T1.event_date LIKE '2019-10-08%'

intent: Calculate the total average cost that Elijah Allen spent in the events on September and October.
description: Elijah Allen is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; The 5th and 6th string of the expense_date in the expense table can refer to month; events in September and October refers to month(expense_date) = 9 OR month(expense_date) = 10
source_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.cost) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.last_name = 'Allen' AND T1.first_name = 'Elijah' AND (SUBSTR(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '09' OR SUBSTR(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '10')

intent: Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.
description: The first 4 strings of the event_date values in the event table can represent year; The difference of the total amount spent = SUBTRACT(spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2019, spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2020)
source_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event

intent: Based on the total cost for all event, what is the percentage of cost for Yearly Kickoff event?
description: percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(cost where event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'), SUM(cost)) * 100
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T3.cost ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T3.cost) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget

intent: What is the ratio between students majored in finance and physics?
description: DIVDE(SUM(major_name = 'Finance'), SUM(major_name = 'Physics'))
source_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN major_name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN major_name = 'Physics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM major

intent: Indicate the top source of funds received in September 2019 based on their amount.
description: top source funds refers to MAX(source); September 2019 means date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' and '2019-09-30'
source_sql: SELECT source FROM income WHERE date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' and '2019-09-30' ORDER BY source DESC LIMIT 1

intent: Provide the full name and email address of the Student_Club's Secretary.
description: full name refers to first_name, last_name; 'Secretary' is a position of Student Club
source_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM member WHERE position = 'Secretary'

intent: How many members of the Student_Club have major in 'Physics Teaching'?
description: 'Physics Teaching' is the major_name;
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.member_id) FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T1.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'

intent: How many members did attend the event 'Community Theater' in 2019?
description: event 'Community Theater' in 2019 refers to event_name = 'Community Theater' where YEAR(event_date) = 2019
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.link_to_member) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'Community Theater' AND SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019'

intent: Provide the number of events attended by Luisa Guidi. What is her major?
description: major refers to major_name;
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T3.link_to_event), T1.major_name FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major INNER JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T2.member_id = T3.link_to_member WHERE T2.first_name = 'Luisa' AND T2.last_name = 'Guidi'

intent: On average, how much did the Student_Club spend on food for the typical event in the past?
description: DIVIDE(SUM(spent), COUNT(spent)) where category = 'Food'; 'event in the past' means event_status = 'Closed'
source_sql: SELECT SUM(spent) / COUNT(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food' AND event_status = 'Closed'

intent: Name the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.
description: Name of event refers to event_name; highest amount spent on advertisement refers to MAX(spent) where category = 'Advertisement'
source_sql: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY T1.spent DESC LIMIT 1

intent: Did Maya Mclean attend the 'Women's Soccer' event?
description: Maya Mclean is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; 'Women's Soccer' is an event_name
source_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN T3.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' THEN 'YES' END AS result FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Maya' AND T1.last_name = 'Mclean'

intent: Among all events hold by the Student_Club in 2019, find the percentage share of events related to 'Community Service'
description: DIVIDE(SUM(type = 'Community Service'), COUNT(event_id)) * 100 where event_date BETWEEN' 2019-01-01' and '2019-12-31'
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Community Service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(type) FROM event WHERE SUBSTR(event_date, 1, 4) = '2019'

intent: Indicate the cost of posters for 'September Speaker' event.
description: 'Posters' is the expense description; 'September Speaker' is an event name
source_sql: SELECT T3.cost FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Speaker' AND T3.expense_description = 'Posters'

intent: What is the most popular size of t-shirt ordered by the club members?
description: most popular size of t-shirt ordered refers to MAX(COUNT(t_shirt_size))
source_sql: SELECT t_shirt_size FROM member GROUP BY t_shirt_size ORDER BY COUNT(t_shirt_size) DESC LIMIT 1

intent: Indicate the name of the closed event whose cost has exceeded the budget the most.
description: closed events refers to event_name where status = 'Closed'; exceed the budget the most refers to MIN(remaining) where remaining < 0
source_sql: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T2.event_id = T1.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_status = 'Closed' AND T1.remaining < 0 ORDER BY T1.remaining LIMIT 1

intent: Identify the type of expenses and their total value approved for 'October Meeting' event.
description: total value refers to SUM(cost); 'October Meeting' is an event name;
source_sql: SELECT T1.type, SUM(T3.cost) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'October Meeting'

intent: Calculate the amount budgeted for 'April Speaker' event. List all the budgeted categories for said event in an ascending order based on their amount budgeted.
description: 'April Speaker' is an event name; amount budgeted refers to SUM(amount); budget categories refers to category
source_sql: SELECT T2.category, SUM(T2.amount) FROM event AS T1 JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'April Speaker' GROUP BY T2.category ORDER BY SUM(T2.amount) ASC

intent: Among the budgets for Food, which one has the highest budgeted amount?
description: MAX(amount) where category = 'Food'
source_sql: SELECT budget_id FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food' AND amount = ( SELECT MAX(amount) FROM budget )

intent: Among the budgets for Advertising, list out top three which have the most budgeted amount?
description: MAX(amount) where category = 'Advertisement'
source_sql: SELECT budget_id FROM budget WHERE category = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3

intent: Calculate the total cost spent for Parking in the list.
description: total cost spent for Parking refers to SUM(cost) where expense_description = 'Parking'
source_sql: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Parking'

intent: Mention the total expense used on 8/20/2019.
description: total expense refers SUM(cost) where expense_date = '2019-08-20'
source_sql: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

intent: List out the full name and total cost that member id "rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v" incurred?
description: full name refers to first_name, last name
source_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, SUM(T2.cost) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v'

intent: State what kind of expenses that Sacha Harrison incurred?
description: kind of expenses refers to expense_description; Sacha Harrison is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;
source_sql: SELECT T2.expense_description FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.first_name = 'Sacha' AND T1.last_name = 'Harrison'

intent: What kind of expenses incurred by members who have X-Large in size of tee shirt?
description: kind of expenses refers to expense_description; t_shirt_size = 'X-Large'
source_sql: SELECT T2.expense_description FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.t_shirt_size = 'X-Large'

intent: Mention the zip code of member who incurred less than 50USD.
description: incurred less than 50USD refers to cost < 50
source_sql: SELECT T1.zip FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T2.cost < 50

intent: State the name of major that Phillip Cullen has joined.
description: name of major refers to major_name
source_sql: SELECT T1.major_name FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T2.first_name = 'Phillip' AND T2.last_name = 'Cullen'

intent: List out the position of members who joined major of Business.
description: 'Business' is the major name
source_sql: SELECT T2.position FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T1.major_name = 'Business'

intent: How many members of Business have the Medium size of tee shirt?
description: members of Economics refers to major_name = 'Business'; t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.member_id) FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T1.major_name = 'Business' AND T2.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

intent: List out the type of events which have remaining budget more than 30 USD.
description: remaining budget more than 30 USD refers to remaining > 30
source_sql: SELECT T1.type FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T2.remaining > 30

intent: Mention the category of events which were held at MU 215.
description: held at MU 215 refers to location = 'MU 215'
source_sql: SELECT T2.category FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215'

intent: What is the category of event which was taken place in 2020-03-24T12:00:00?
description: taken place in 2020-03-24T12:00:00 refers to event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00'
source_sql: SELECT T2.category FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00'

intent: State the name of major that Vice President has joined.
description: name of major refers to major_name; 'Vice President' is position of Student Club
source_sql: SELECT T1.major_name FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T2.position = 'Vice President'

intent: Calculate the percentage of members who are major Business in the list?
description: DIVIDE(SUM(position = 'Member' and major_name = 'Business'), COUNT(member_id)) * 100
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.major_name = 'Business' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.member_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major WHERE T1.position = 'Member'

intent: State the category of events were held at MU 215.
description: 'MU 215' is the location of event;
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.category FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215'

intent: How many income are received with an amount of 50?
description: amount of 50 refers to amount = 50
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(income_id) FROM income WHERE amount = 50

intent: Among the members, how many of them have an extra large t-shirt size?
description: among the members refers to position = 'Member'; extra large t-shirt size refers to t_shirt_size = 'X-Large'
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(member_id) FROM member WHERE position = 'Member' AND t_shirt_size = 'X-Large'

intent: In the College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences, how many majors are under the department of School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education?
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(major_id) FROM major WHERE department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education' AND college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'

intent: List the last name of members with a major in environmental engineering and include its department and college name.
description: 'Environmental Engineering' is the major_name;
source_sql: SELECT T2.last_name, T1.department, T1.college FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T2.position = 'Member' AND T1.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'

intent: What are the budget category of the events located at MU 215 and a guest speaker type with a 0 budget spent?
description: budget category refers to category; events located at refers to location; type = 'Guest Speaker'; 0 budget spent refers to spent = 0;
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.category, T1.type FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215' AND T2.spent = 0 AND T1.type = 'Guest Speaker'

intent: List the city and state of members enrolled under electrical and computer engineering department.
description: 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department' is the department; members enrolled refers to position = 'Member'
source_sql: SELECT city, state FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major INNER JOIN zip_code AS T3 ON T3.zip_code = T1.zip WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department' AND position = 'Member'

intent: What is the name of the social event that was attended by the vice president of the Student_Club located at 900 E. Washington St.?
description: name of social event refers to event_name where type = 'Social'; 'Vice President' is position; located at refers to location
source_sql: SELECT T2.event_name FROM attendance AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T2.event_id = T1.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T1.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T3.position = 'Vice President' AND T2.location = '900 E. Washington St.' AND T2.type = 'Social'

intent: What is the last name and position of the student that bought pizza on 09/10/2019?
description: bought pizza on 09/10/2019 refers to expense_description = 'Pizza' where expense_date = '2019-09-10'
source_sql: SELECT T1.last_name, T1.position FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T2.expense_date = '2019-09-10' AND T2.expense_description = 'Pizza'

intent: List the last name of the members of the club that attended the women's soccer event.
description: members of the club refers to position = 'Member'; 'Women's Soccer' is event name;
source_sql: SELECT T3.last_name FROM attendance AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T2.event_id = T1.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T1.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T2.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' AND T3.position = 'Member'

intent: Among the members with t-shirt size of medium, what is the percentage of the amount 50 received by the Student_Club?
description: t_shirt_size = 'Medium' where position = 'Member'; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(amount = 50), COUNT(member_id)) * 100
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.amount = 50 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.income_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Member' AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

intent: Which countries have zip codes with post office boxes?
description: zip codes that have post office boxes refers to type = 'PO Box'
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT county FROM zip_code WHERE type = 'PO Box' AND county IS NOT NULL

intent: What are the zip codes that have post office boxes in the country of the country of San Juan Municipio whose state is Puerto Rico?
description: zip codes that have post office boxes refers to type = 'PO Box'
source_sql: SELECT zip_code FROM zip_code WHERE type = 'PO Box' AND county = 'San Juan Municipio' AND state = 'Puerto Rico'

intent: List the names of closed event as "game" that was closed from 3/15/2019 to 3/20/2020.
description: name of events refers event_name; game event that was closed refers to type = 'Game' where status = 'Closed'; event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' and '2020-03-20';
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND date(SUBSTR(event_date, 1, 10)) BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20' AND status = 'Closed'

intent: Please provide links to events for members who have paid more than 50 dollar.
description: have paid more than 50 dollar refers to cost > 50
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.link_to_event FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T2.member_id = T3.link_to_member WHERE T1.cost > 50

intent: Which members who were approved from 1/10/2019 to 11/19/2019? Please identify the member who attended the event and the link to their event.
description: approved from 1/10/2019 to 11/19/2019 refers to approved = 'true' and expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' and '2019-11-19'
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.link_to_member, T3.link_to_event FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T2.member_id = T3.link_to_member WHERE date(SUBSTR(T1.expense_date, 1, 10)) BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19' AND T1.approved = 'true'

intent: Please indicate the college of the person whose first name is Katy with the link to the major "rec1N0upiVLy5esTO".
source_sql: SELECT T2.college FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major WHERE T1.link_to_major = 'rec1N0upiVLy5esTO' AND T1.first_name = 'Katy'

intent: Please list the phone numbers of the members who majored in business at the College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences.
description: 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences' is the college; majored in business refers to major_name = 'Business'; phone numbers refers to phone
source_sql: SELECT T1.phone FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major WHERE T2.major_name = 'Business' AND T2.college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'

intent: List emails of people who paid more than 20 dollars from 9/10/2019 to 11/19/2019.
description: expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' and '2019-11-19'; cost > 20
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.email FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE date(SUBSTR(T2.expense_date, 1, 10)) BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19' AND T2.cost > 20

intent: How many members have education major in the College of Education & Human Services?
description: 'education' is the major name; 'Member' is a position of club;
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major WHERE T1.position = 'Member' AND T2.major_name LIKE '%Education%' AND T2.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'

intent: What is the percentage of the events that went over budget?
description: went over budget refers to remaining < 0; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(remaining < 0), COUNT(event_id)) * 100
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN remaining < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(budget_id) FROM budget

intent: Give the event ID, location, and status of events conducted from November 2019 to March 2020.
description: event_date BETWEEN '2019-11-01' and '2020-03-31'
source_sql: SELECT event_id, location, status FROM event WHERE date(SUBSTR(event_date, 1, 10)) BETWEEN '2019-11-01' AND '2020-03-31'

intent: List the expenses that spend more than fifty dollars on average.
description: expense refers to expense_description; spend more than fifty dollars on average refers to DIVIDE( SUM(cost), COUNT(expense_id) ) > 50
source_sql: SELECT expense_description FROM expense GROUP BY expense_description HAVING AVG(cost) > 50

intent: Find the full name of members whose t-shirt size is extra large.
description: full name refers to first_name, last_name; t_shirt_size = 'X-Large'
source_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM member WHERE t_shirt_size = 'X-Large'

intent: Calculate the percentage of zip codes that are PO boxes.
description: DIVIDE(SUM(type = 'PO Box'), COUNT(zip_code)) * 100
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PO Box' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(zip_code) FROM zip_code

intent: List the name and location of events that underspend its budget.
description: name of event refers to event_name; underspend its budget refers to remaining > 0
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.event_name, T1.location FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T2.remaining > 0

intent: Find the name and date of events with expenses for pizza that were more than fifty dollars but less than a hundred dollars.
description: name of event refers to event_name; date of event refers to event_date; expenses for pizza refers to expense_description = 'Pizza' where cost > 50 and cost < 100
source_sql: SELECT T1.event_name, T1.event_date FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T3.expense_description = 'Pizza' AND T3.cost > 50 AND T3.cost < 100

intent: What is the name and major of members who had to spend more than a hundred dollars on an expense?
description: full name refers to first_name, last_name; major of members refers to major_name; spend more than a hundred dollars on an expense refers to cost > 100
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T1.member_id = T3.link_to_member WHERE T3.cost > 100

intent: In the events with more than forty incomes, list the city and country in which the event is happening.
description: more than fifty incomes refers to income > 40
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.city, T3.county FROM income AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN zip_code AS T3 ON T3.zip_code = T2.zip WHERE T1.amount > 40

intent: Among the members who incurred expenses in more than one event, who paid the most amount?
description: paid the most amount refers to for expense incurred in more than one event refers to MAX(cost where COUNT(event_id) > 1)
source_sql: SELECT T2.member_id FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T1.link_to_budget = T3.budget_id INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3.link_to_event = T4.event_id GROUP BY T2.member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T4.event_id) > 1 ORDER BY SUM(T1.cost) DESC LIMIT 1

intent: What is the average amount paid by students in a position other than a member?
description: position other than a member refers to position ! = 'Member'; average amount paid = DIVIDE( SUM(cost), COUNT(event_id))
source_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.cost) FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member as T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id WHERE T2.position != 'Member'

intent: List the name of events with less than average parking cost.
description: name of events refers to event_name; less than average parking cost refers to cost < DIVIDE(SUM(cost), COUNT(event_id)) where category = 'Parking'
source_sql: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T2.category = 'Parking' AND T3.cost < (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

intent: What is the percentage of the cost for the meeting events?
description: meeting events refers to type = 'Meeting'; percentage = DIVIDE( SUM(cost), COUNT(event_id)) * 100
source_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.type = 'Meeting' THEN T3.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100 / SUM(T3.cost) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget

intent: Which budget allowed the most money for water, chips, and cookies?
description: budget allowed refers to expense_description; expense_description = 'Water, chips, cookies'; most money refers to MAX(cost)
source_sql: SELECT T2.budget_id FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id WHERE T1.expense_description = 'Water, chips, cookies' ORDER BY T1.cost DESC LIMIT 1

intent: List the full name of the top five members who spend the most money in the descending order of spending.
description: full name refers to first_name, last_name; spend the most money refers to MAX(expense.cost)
source_sql: SELECT T3.first_name, T3.last_name FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T1.link_to_member = T3.member_id ORDER BY T2.spent DESC LIMIT 5

intent: Give the full name and contact number of members who had to spend more than average on each expense.
description: full name refers to first_name, last_name; contact number refers to phone; had spent more than average on each expense refers to cost > AVG(cost)
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.first_name, T3.last_name, T3.phone FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member WHERE T1.cost > ( SELECT AVG(T1.cost) FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member )

intent: Calculate the difference in the percentage of members in New Jersey and Vermont.
description: SUBTRACT( DIVIDE( SUM(state = 'New Jersey'), COUNT(position = 'Member')), DIVIDE( SUM(state = 'Vermont'), COUNT(position = 'Member')) )
source_sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2.state = 'New Jersey' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.state = 'Vermont' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.member_id) AS diff FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip

intent: What is the major of Garrett Gerke and which department does it belong to?
description: major refers to major name;
source_sql: SELECT T2.major_name, T2.department FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

intent: Write the full name of the member who spent money for water, veggie tray and supplies and include the cost of it.
description: full name refers to first_name, last name; spent money for refers expense description; expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'
source_sql: SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T1.cost FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id WHERE T1.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'

intent: List the last names of students under the Elementary Education major and include their phone numbers.
description: 'Elementary Education' is the major name; phone numbers refers to phone
source_sql: SELECT T1.last_name, T1.phone FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major WHERE T2.major_name = 'Elementary Education'

intent: What category was budgeted for the 'January Speaker' event and how much was the amount budgeted for that category?
description: amount budgeted refers to amount, 'January Speaker' is the event name;
source_sql: SELECT T2.category, T2.amount FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'January Speaker'

intent: List the event names which were budgeted for the food.
description: budgeted for food refers to category = 'Food'
source_sql: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T2.category = 'Food'

intent: Write the full names of students who received funds on the date of 9/9/2019 and include the amount received.
description: full name refers to first_name, last_name, amount of funds received refers to amount, received funds on date refers to date_received
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.first_name, T3.last_name, T4.amount FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T2.link_to_member INNER JOIN income AS T4 ON T4.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T4.date_received = '2019-09-09'

intent: Which budget category does the expense 'Posters' fall to?
description: 'Posters' refers to expense description
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.category FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id WHERE T1.expense_description = 'Posters'

intent: Write the full name of the club member with the position of 'Secretary' and list which college the club member belongs to.
description: full name refers to first_name, last name
source_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, college FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major WHERE T1.position = 'Secretary'

intent: Calculate the total amount spent on speaker gifts and list the name of the event they were spent on.
description: total amount spent = SUM(spent) where category = 'Speaker Gifts'
source_sql: SELECT SUM(T1.spent), T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Speaker Gifts' GROUP BY T2.event_name

intent: Where is the hometown of Garrett Gerke?
description: hometown refers to city
source_sql: SELECT T2.city FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

intent: Which student has the hometown of Lincolnton, North Carolina with the zip code of 28092? List their full name and position.
description: full name refers to first_name, last_name, hometown of Lincolnton, North Carolina refers to city = 'Lincolnton' AND state = 'North Carolina'
source_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.position FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip WHERE T2.city = 'Lincolnton' AND T2.state = 'North Carolina' AND T2.zip_code = 28092
